confidence_notes: Food anchors use October 2026 Numbeo city averages. Cocktail pricing comes from a smaller-sample current index; wine is estimated at roughly three draft-beer prices. Accommodation remains a holistic estimate based on the supplied Vietnamese comparables.
comparable_city_reasoning: Da Nang's broad hotel supply suggests basic rooms and hostel beds below Hoi An and Ninh Binh, but above lower-cost Da Lat. Year-round city and beach demand puts three-star rooms around Hoi An and below Sa Pa and Ninh Binh.
